fields.label: Webhook Rate Limit (per minute, per caller IP)
fields.description: Inbound deliveries accepted from one caller address in a minute, on each webhook endpoint. Past the cap the provider is answered 429 and backs off, and its own retry re-delivers the message, so nothing is dropped. Left at 0 the built-in default applies (600 for WhatsApp).

fields.label: Template Rate Caps (manual sends, per lead)

fields.description: Manual template sends allowed to one lead in a rolling hour — the chat-box picker only, so automated and rule-driven sends are never throttled. Left blank the default of 5 applies; an explicit 0 removes the cap.
fields.label: Template Cap / Hour

fields.description: The same cap over a rolling 24 hours, so a lead cannot be drip-messaged all day inside the hourly limit. Left blank the default of 10 applies; an explicit 0 removes the cap.
fields.label: Template Cap / Day
